title: “The bravest thing you’ll ever do is bow.”
paragraphs: “The bravest thing you’ll ever do is bow.”

Not every battle needs your sword.
Power isn’t lost in surrender — it’s revealed.
“But he said to me, ‘My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.’ Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.”
→ Summary: Divine strength reveals itself not through human might, but through humble dependence.
